lines.en: why do you embroider so sadly, and weep,

lines.cyr: што тажно везиш моме, ем плачеш?
lines.lat: što tažno veziš mome, em plačeš?
lines.en: why do you embroider so sadly, girl, and weep?

lines.cyr: Дали ти се мрси конецот, леле конецот,
lines.lat: Dali ti se mrsi konecot, lele konecot,
lines.en: Is the thread getting tangled, oh the thread,
or is it longing that torments you,
or is it longing that torments you, girl?

lines.cyr: - Не ми се мрси конецот, леле конецот,
lines.lat: - Ne mi se mrsi konecot, lele konecot,
lines.en: - The thread is not getting tangled, oh the thread,
it is only longing that torments me,
it is only longing that torments me, my dear.

lines.cyr: Сношти ми се либето армаса, леле армаса,
lines.lat: Snošti mi se libeto armasa, lele armasa,
lines.en: Last night my sweetheart was engaged, oh engaged,
to my first, my dear, enemy.
